suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease transformation. Require established polycythemia vera followed by documented leukemic transformation, specifically AML where supported. PV can progress to AML but transformation is not inevitable and the generic leukemia target must remain AML-bounded. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Polycythemia Vera and Leukemia (Acute & Chronic)
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
